title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SpecialDayEntry
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SpecialDayEntry. This class represents the parameters that are needed by an activity calendar for adding a new special day. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own ComplexActionOperationInput; inherits obtainInputFromObis (documented on the CosemOperationInput model and not repeated here).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SpecialDayEntry'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasIndex.description: Property. It defines the index of the special day.

hasSpecialDate.description: Property. It defines the date at which a normal day is considered a special date.

hasDayId.description: Property. It defines the unique identifier of a day.
